The Goblin Engineer (1/2) is going to die in combat regardless. By targeting the Orc Army Token, the bolt could have killed it, saving the Goblin Engineer from lethal combat damage (it would only take 1 from Bowmasters, surviving as a 1/2). Alternatively, targeting Orcish Bowmasters would kill it. Instead, GPT52 Nature wasted a Lightning Bolt dealing 3 damage to themselves while losing their Goblin Engineer in combat.
